daily.today_energy: Mercury's whispering something real today—you're in a listening phase. Trust those quiet gut hits over the noise. Your vibe is magnetic when you're authentically present, so lean into that.
daily.love: Someone's noticing the shift in your energy. Whether it's new or existing connections, vulnerability looks good on you rn. Stop overthinking the 'what ifs' and just show up as you are.
daily.career: Your natural ability to see multiple sides of things is your superpower today. Speak up in that meeting or project discussion—your perspective matters more than you think.
daily.health: Your body's asking for slower, intentional movement today. Think yoga or walks over intensity. Hydrate like it's a spiritual practice and check in with what your nervous system actually needs.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to trust your gut more than your overthinking brain. Venus is vibing with your sector of self-discovery, so lean into what feels authentic rather than what looks good on the surface.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or flying solo, this is about knowing your worth. Someone might test your boundaries—stay grounded. If you're dating, quality over quantity energy is *chef's kiss* right now.
weekly.career: Mercury's got your back with communication vibes. That idea you've been sitting on? Now's the time to pitch it or at least talk it through. Your voice carries more weight than you realize this week.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for genuine rest, not just scrolling in bed. Movement that feels good—dancing, walks, whatever—will shift your whole mood. Hydration is lowkey your secret weapon.
